title: Programming foundations and safe repository workflow

evidence.claimBoundary: This manifest designs learning probes over authorized fixture repositories; it does not claim repository indexing, grounded explanation, patching, or test execution is currently available through seed files.

objective: Acquire a grounded repository model and a reusable inspect-hypothesize-change-test workflow that explains code from observed evidence and keeps mutation scoped and reversible.

included: scoped repository tree and file observations
manifest, language, module, symbol, type, import, and test relationships
diagnostic interpretation and evidence-linked repository explanations
inspect -> hypothesize -> minimal patch -> focused checks -> evaluate workflow
excluded: unreviewed broad rewrites or dependency upgrades
network access and credentials unless separately granted
claims unsupported by observed files, diagnostics, or test output

teacherSuppliedFields: pure procedure bodies and contract checks

requiredNativeOperations.name: observation.repository_tree
requiredNativeOperations.role: Observe a bounded, authorized repository tree with fingerprints.

requiredNativeOperations.name: observation.file_content_scoped
requiredNativeOperations.role: Read named files and source spans within an explicit fixture boundary.

requiredNativeOperations.name: observation.parse_source_spans
requiredNativeOperations.role: Extract syntax, symbols, types, imports, and diagnostics with provenance.

requiredNativeOperations.name: sandbox.run_focused_check
requiredNativeOperations.role: Run a bounded compiler, formatter, linter, or test command in a sandbox.

requiredNativeOperations.name: repository.diff_scoped
requiredNativeOperations.role: Inspect and constrain a proposed change before applying it.

requiredNativeOperations.name: repository.patch_scoped
requiredNativeOperations.role: Apply only an authorized minimal patch and retain a reversible diff.

requiredNativeOperations.name: programming.ir_lower_typed_ast
requiredNativeOperations.role: Lower neutral Spoon semantics into a typed target AST with source maps and explicit runtime shims.

requiredNativeOperations.name: programming.ast_lift_ir_candidate
requiredNativeOperations.role: Lift representable source AST regions into neutral candidate procedures with source-span provenance.

requiredNativeOperations.name: programming.differential_equivalence
requiredNativeOperations.role: Compare IR and generated-code outputs, failures, effects, and resource envelopes over bounded cases.

requiredCapabilities.name: repository.fixture.read
requiredCapabilities.purpose: Read a named synthetic repository fixture and its manifests, source, tests, and diagnostics.
requiredCapabilities.fixtureBoundary: one fixture repository root selected by the local operator

requiredCapabilities.name: repository.fixture.test
requiredCapabilities.purpose: Execute a bounded focused check against the selected fixture with declared resource limits.
requiredCapabilities.fixtureBoundary: sandboxed fixture process with no ambient network

requiredCapabilities.name: repository.fixture.patch
requiredCapabilities.purpose: Permit a minimal reversible patch only inside a selected fixture worktree.
requiredCapabilities.fixtureBoundary: operator-approved fixture worktree; no parent traversal

demonstrations.purpose: Build a grounded repository model from bounded tree, manifest, source, and test observations.

taskModel.inputShape: a small authorized fixture repository containing a manifest, multiple modules, symbols, imports, and focused tests
taskModel.operation: observe files and source spans, detect toolchain, and construct evidence-linked repository relationships

expectedBehavior: Every repository claim links to an observed file or span.
The model records modules, symbols, imports, tests, and toolchain assumptions.
Unobserved behavior remains uncertain.

assertions: Independent tree and source observations support the model.
The model does not contain ambient paths or secrets.

demonstrations.purpose: Show the safe inspect-hypothesize-change-test loop on an authorized fixture with a narrow failing check.

taskModel.inputShape: a fixture repository with one intentional, localized test failure and an explicit change boundary
taskModel.operation: inspect evidence, state a hypothesis, propose a minimal patch, run a focused check, and evaluate the diff

expectedBehavior: Inspect before mutating.
Patch only within the approved scope.
Run the smallest relevant check and retain failure evidence if it does not pass.

assertions: The focused check gives a reproducible result.
The diff is bounded and explainable.

counterexamples.purpose: Reject fluent explanations that assert modules, behavior, or dependencies not supported by repository evidence.

taskModel.inputShape: a repository question whose tempting answer mentions an absent symbol, file, dependency, or runtime behavior
taskModel.operation: compare proposed claims against observed tree, source spans, manifests, tests, and diagnostics

expectedBehavior: Reject unsupported claims or mark them uncertain.
Cite the evidence used for each accepted claim.
Ask for observation or scope when evidence is missing.

assertions: Unsupported claims are not presented as facts.
Evidence links are preserved in the response plan.

counterexamples.failureSignal: A plausible narrative is accepted without a matching file, symbol, test, or observed diagnostic.

counterexamples.purpose: Reject a workflow that mutates outside scope or skips focused validation.

taskModel.inputShape: a fixture with a localized defect and a proposed patch that touches unrelated files or runs an unbounded command
taskModel.operation: check authority, diff scope, resource bounds, and validation ordering before execution

expectedBehavior: Deny out-of-scope writes.
Require explicit bounded execution policy.
Keep the original failure and proposal inspectable.

assertions: Permission and scope checks run before mutation.
Denied actions do not partially change the fixture.

counterexamples.failureSignal: The proposed workflow writes broadly, uses ambient authority, or changes code before inspection.

exercises.purpose: Explain a fixture repository at the requested altitude using only the acquired repository model.

taskModel.inputShape: an unseen repository question about purpose, entrypoint, module relationships, test strategy, or toolchain
taskModel.operation: retrieve evidence-linked structure and produce a concise response plan with uncertainty

expectedBehavior: Answer from observed structure.
Distinguish direct evidence from inference.
Preserve conversational corrections as revised hypotheses, not silent rewrites.

assertions: Claims can be traced to fixture evidence.
The explanation avoids unsupported implementation detail.

exercises.purpose: Practice a bounded code change and focused test workflow on a new localized fixture failure.

taskModel.inputShape: an authorized fixture worktree with a reproducible failing test, explicit writable files, and a bounded test command
taskModel.operation: inspect, hypothesize, patch in scope, run focused checks, evaluate, and retain or revise

expectedBehavior: Record hypothesis before patch.
Apply the smallest reversible change.
Run focused checks before claiming success.
Report unresolved failures rather than hiding them.

assertions: Scope and permission checks pass before write.
Focused test result and diff are retained.
A clean result is reproducible in the fixture.

heldOutGeneralization.purpose: Test repository explanation on an unseen fixture layout and toolchain without Teacher assistance.

taskModel.inputShape: an unseen authorized repository with a different manifest layout, module naming convention, and test command
taskModel.operation: detect toolchain, index evidence, and explain entrypoints and dependencies with Teacher OFF

expectedBehavior: Use observed manifests and files rather than prior fixture names.
Keep toolchain assumptions evidence-linked.
Remain Teacher-OFF throughout observation and explanation.

assertions: Repository claims are grounded in the held-out fixture.

heldOutGeneralization.purpose: Test the safe workflow on an unseen failure mode while preserving scope, denial, and rollback behavior.

taskModel.inputShape: an unseen fixture failure with an explicit writable boundary, one focused check, and a distractor broad change
taskModel.operation: diagnose from evidence, select a minimal patch, deny the distractor, and run the focused check

expectedBehavior: No broad or ambient mutation occurs.
Denied proposals remain visible as failures.
The selected patch and test outcome are reproducible without Teacher.

assertions: The focused check and diff satisfy the fixture contract.

semanticProperties: symbols, modules, imports, tests, and diagnostics
expectedLearnedStructures.compositionRole: Grounds explanations and workflow decisions in observed repository evidence.
Constrains conversational explanation and correction handling.
Provides a safe reusable change loop.
Prevents ambient authority and silent failure in programming workflows.
Protects repository explanations and safe changes from fluency shortcuts.

semanticProperties: neutral operation to typed AST mappings
explicit target runtime shims and imports
expectedLearnedStructures.compositionRole: Lets one learned procedure become verified target-language code and lets recognizable code become a neutral candidate without confusing syntax with semantics.

passCriteria: Known repository facts are retrieved from evidence without Teacher.
Scope and permission checks precede any proposed write.

requires: repository model and workflow are available
passCriteria: Observation, explanation, patch proposal, and focused test compose.
The response plan links claims to evidence.
The workflow does not claim success before checks.
Unseen layout and toolchain are grounded from local evidence.
An unseen failure is handled with a minimal scoped change.

requires: bundle has no ambient paths or grants
passCriteria: Repository model and workflow reconstruct on a clean target.
Held-out explanation and safe-test probes pass with Teacher OFF.
No write authority or trust receipt transfers with the bundle.

allow: synthetic repository manifests and source shapes
workflow contracts and bounded test recipes
deny: private repository contents and user identifiers
provider prompts, hidden state, and trust receipts
unredacted source excerpts outside synthetic fixtures
redactions: replace repository names and paths with fixture-relative descriptors
retain only minimal source spans needed to reconstruct a test

notes: The fixture repository is an explicit capability boundary, not ambient workspace access.
A future runner must record source evidence, proposed effects, denied actions, diffs, focused test results, and Teacher usage separately.
